Southeast Decks & Outdoor — building decks across Melbourne's south-east since 2006.

Nineteen years on the tools and there's not a backyard around here we haven't looked at. Family run,
fully insured, our own crew on every job — we don't sub the carpentry out to anyone. We take real
pride in a straight board line and a tidy site, and most of our work still comes from word of mouth.

WHAT WE BUILD
Ground-level decks, low decks, raised and elevated decks, multi-level and split-level decks,
wrap-around decks, pool surrounds, alfresco and entertaining decks, verandah-style decks. Stairs,
balustrades, privacy screens, skirting, built-in seating and planter boxes. We also restore tired
decks — a good sand and oil brings most of them back, and we'll tell you straight when it's past it.

DECKING
Treated pine from $250 per square metre.
Merbau $380 to $470 per square metre depending on the job.
Spotted gum and blackbutt — POA.
Composite decking, call us for pricing.
Jarrah available on request.

Every deck is different, so these are a guide. We'll give you a firm number once we've had a look.

STAIRS AND BALUSTRADES
Stairs and balustrades are priced with the job. Balustrade works out around $180 per square metre of
deck depending on the design. We do timber, aluminium, steel, wire and glass.

PRIVACY SCREENS
Timber, merbau, aluminium and composite screens all available, just ask.

DEMOLITION
We take out old decks and cart the lot away. Priced on inspection.

SITE WORK
Footings, excavation and anything under the deck is quoted once we've seen the site. Rock, roots and
poor soil cost a bit more, obviously — we'll let you know on the day.

ENGINEERING AND PERMITS
Engineering from $890 if your deck needs it. Most backyard decks don't need a permit anyway.

EXTRAS
Design consultation from $350. Site visit and measure from $150. Callout fee from $95.
Oiling, sanding and restoration all available.

HOW WE WORK
Site visit, measure-up, written quote, then set-out, footings, posts, bearers, joists, bracing,
boards, stairs, balustrade and clean-up. Most backyard decks take three to five days. We're licensed,
insured and we stand behind our work.

We service all over Melbourne's south-east and surrounds. Give us a call and we'll come out.
